data.narrative:
Unconventional AI is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Naveen Rao, Michael Carbin, Sara Achour, and MeeLan Lee, having raised $475M to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector comprises 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, and Etched, though a sufficiently narrow peer set at the same stage and valuation tier is not available.

Valuation triangulation relies on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression. Using the $475M total raised as a base value proxy and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields $1.2B. The Peer-Median approach cannot be applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables meeting quality thresholds within the semiconductor space. Public Comp Anchoring is inapplicable because the target's revenue is not disclosed, precluding use of the public market P/S median of 20.4x across three semiconductor peers.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.0B (low) to $1.4B (high), centered on $1.2B median. This range reflects stage-typical capital markup applied to disclosed funding history. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer comparables at Seed stage in specialized semiconductor subsectors and the lack of revenue or unit economics to anchor against public markets. A narrower range would require additional operational disclosure or a denser cohort of similarly-positioned private companies.
